profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Python • JavaScript • AWS • Scalable Systems | React | SQL | APIs
profile.summary: Full Stack Java Developer with 4+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable applications in Healthcare and Financial domains. Proficient in front-end and back-end technologies, delivering high-quality software solutions aligned with business requirements. Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React, RESTful APIs, and Microservices architecture. Skilled in cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, with experience in containerization using Docker and Kubernetes. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to enhance application performance and user experience.

positions.title: Full Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed Healthcare Insurance Claim Management Portal using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and MySQL for seamless claim submission and tracking. 
• Created Claim Submission Forms with interactive UI components using Angular and TypeScript, enhancing user experience and accessibility. 
• Developed and exposed RESTful APIs for claim submission, validation, approval, and status tracking using Spring Boot. 
• Implemented Kafka-based Asynchronous Processing to decouple services and improve system performance for claim validation and notifications. 
• Integrated JWT-based Authentication and Authorization to ensure secure access to portal features with role-based access control. 
• Built Admin Dashboard using Angular to monitor claims, generate reports, and manage claim status in real-time. 
• Optimized SQL Queries and database design for faster claim retrieval and data consistency using Hibernate ORM. 
• Created automated workflows for Claim Validation and Approval based on business rules and configurable parameters. 
• Designed Microservices Architecture for scalable and independent claim processing components using Spring Boot. 
• Configured Kafka Producers and Consumers to handle claim notifications and approval status asynchronously. 
• Developed Email Notification System using Spring Boot Mail API to notify users of claim status updates. 
• Implemented Unit and Integration Testing using JUnit and Mockito to ensure code quality and system stability. 
• Deployed application components using Docker Containers and managed deployments through Kubernetes. 
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments, participating in sprint planning, reviews, and daily stand-ups. 
• Utilized Jira for task tracking, bug reporting, and sprint backlog management in Agile projects. 
• Maintained version control using Git and performed code reviews to ensure best coding practices and design patterns.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Payment Gateway Integration System using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and MySQL to process secure online transactions.
• Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for payment gateway integration and transaction status tracking.
• Developed User Authentication and Authorization using JWT-based Token System for secure access to payment services.
• Integrated Third-Party Payment Gateway APIs for seamless payment processing.
• Built interactive User Interface (UI) using Angular for payment initiation and tracking.
• Implemented Refund Processing Module with automated workflows for partial and full refunds.
• Developed Transaction Status Tracking System using Spring Boot to monitor payment progress and update users.
• Utilized Spring Security to enable role-based access control and data encryption.
• Created Custom Exception Handlers to manage payment failures and notify users via email.
• Integrated Email Notifications System for successful payment confirmations and refund updates.
• Performed CRUD Operations on MySQL using Hibernate ORM and Spring Data JPA for payment data storage.
• Configured Global Exception Handling to ensure robust error management across APIs.
• Developed Unit and Integration Tests using JUnit and Mockito to validate business logic and API endpoints.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile Scrum environments, participating in sprint planning and daily stand-ups.
• Utilized Kafka for asynchronous messaging in payment notifications and updates.
• Deployed application components using Docker Containers and maintained environments through Kubernetes.
• Managed version control using Git and conducted peer code reviews for quality assurance.
• Used Jira to track project tasks, report bugs, and manage project backlogs.
